cs.t: Any of the larger Matias keyboards. I love my Matias mini with quiet clicks. It took a couple of days to get used to, but I don't think I will ever look elsewhere. If you want actually tactile switches stear clear of Mx brown. The quiet clicks have had some reliability issues. The clickies have not. If you like linear switches, maybe look on any of the contactless keyboards. Wooting, razer huntsman, varmilos electrocapacitive, or steelseries. Those will be much nicer feeling than something like a contact-based linear switch.
